name: Zotero
title: Zotero: free EndNote alternative
hook: EndNote charges you two hundred seventy five bucks to manage your research and citations. This app does it for free.
job: Cites all your sources for you

features.say: One click in your browser saves any paper or web page.
Then it writes your citations in Word or Google Docs, in thousands of styles.
You can read and highlight PDFs inside the app.

caption:
EndNote charges $275 to manage your research and citations. Zotero does it for free 📚

✅ Browser button saves any paper or web page in one click
✅ Citations and bibliographies in Word and Google Docs, thousands of styles
✅ Read and highlight PDFs inside the app
✅ No subscription, no ads, no sign-up needed

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ Syncing is free up to 300 MB of storage. More sync storage is a paid add-on (from $20/year). Using Zotero without syncing is fully free. EndNote's $275 is the one-time full license for new buyers
